title: HB83 (2025 Regular): AN ACT relating to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/25RS/hb83/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3040998))
provenance.note: As-filed (BR 1037, 1/3/2025); no passage vote in the record.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (2) A police department, law enforcement agency, or officer of the Commonwealth shall not enforce an order under a red flag law when the person against whom the order is directed has the lawful right under the laws of this Commonwealth to possess firearms.
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (3) A court shall not issue an order under any red flag law to deprive a citizen of this Commonwealth of his or her right to possess firearms, firearms accessories, or ammunition.
